items.title: Frank Amacker Interview, 1960-09-30
items.q: Dick Brady and Gene Brady, heard those two brothers? Didn't you? ... Dick Brady and Gene Brady. That was two popular brothers too.

ctx.x: Mostly by himself. Mostly by himself. He played all the jobs by himself. Lewis played in Spotenhouses by himself, mostly. Very few bands he played with. Had a good player. Dick Brady and Gene Brady, heard those two brothers? Didn't you?
